tools.description: Search indexed document corpora. Pass the scope as corpora=["name"] (a LIST). Omitting corpora searches EVERY corpus, so scope explicitly when the user names one. Call status first if you do not know the corpus names. Returns results with chunk_id, summary, location, corpus, topic and score; follow up with get_chunk for full text.

corpora.description: LIST of corpus names to search, e.g. ["epm-docs"]. Other tools take corpus="name" (singular); this one is plural and takes an array. Omit to search all corpora.

hybrid.description: Override BM25+dense hybrid retrieval. Omit to use the deployment default from config (search.hybrid), which is what you almost always want.

max_chars.description: Threshold for auto return_mode (total result chars). Default: 8000.

max_distance.description: Relevance floor for dense hits, expressed as 1 - cosine similarity (0 = identical, 2 = opposite). Hits below the floor are dropped before fusion; a corpus's own setting wins over this. Omit to use the config value (usually no floor). Lower = stricter.

return_mode.description: Result granularity: 'chunks' returns individual chunks (default), 'documents' returns full source documents deduplicated by path, 'auto' returns chunks if total size < max_chars threshold, otherwise documents.

section_filter.description: Restrict search to a section ID or heading path prefix, e.g. 'Chapter 3'. Only has effect when section_mode is true; ignored otherwise.

section_mode.description: If true, group results by section and return full section text. Default: false.

tools.name: search

tools.description: Retrieve the full text of a specific chunk by its chunk_id. Use after search to get complete content.

chunk_id.description: Chunk ID from search results (format: corpus:stable_id).

tools.name: get_chunk

tools.description: Retrieve the full converted text (markdown) of a document by corpus name and source_path. Returns text content plus metadata (filename, file size, chunk count).

corpus.description: Single corpus name (not a list), e.g. 'epm-docs'.

source_path.description: Absolute path to the source file (from list_documents or search results).

tools.name: get_document

tools.description: List all indexed documents in a corpus (or all corpora if no corpus specified). Returns source_path, filename, chunk count, file size, and last_indexed timestamp for each document.

corpus.description: Single corpus name (not a list). Omit to list every corpus.

tools.name: list_documents

tools.description: Trigger indexing for a specific corpus or all corpora. Incremental by default (only indexes changed files).

corpus.description: Single corpus name (not a list), or 'all'.

force.description: Force re-index all files (ignore hash cache).

tools.name: index

tools.description: List the configured corpora with chunk counts, indexed files, BM25 availability and the active relevance floor (max_distance). Call this first to learn valid corpus names before searching or scoping other tools.
tools.name: status

tools.description: List corpora that accept file uploads via the upload tool. Returns corpus name, path, topic, and allowed extensions.
tools.name: list_folders

tools.description: Upload a file to a corpus for conversion and indexing. The file content must be base64-encoded. Only corpora configured in upload.allow can receive files. Overwriting an existing filename is refused unless the server uploaded that file itself (it is tracked in the upload manifest) or the corpus sets upload.replace to true.

corpus.description: Single corpus name (not a list); must be in upload.allow.

index.description: If true (default), index the corpus after upload.

tools.name: upload

tools.description: Get the table of contents for a corpus or a specific document. Returns a nested tree of headings with chunk counts, or a list of documents with their top-level headings. Non-structured documents return a structured=false flag.

document.description: Optional: specific document source path to get ToC for. If omitted, lists all documents.

tools.name: get_toc

tools.description: Delete a file from a corpus that accepts uploads. Only corpora configured in upload.allow can have files deleted, and only files the server uploaded itself (tracked in the upload manifest) may be deleted. A file whose content was edited outside the API is refused as drift. The corpus is re-indexed after deletion to remove stale chunks.

corpus.description: Single corpus name (not a list); must be in upload.allow.

index.description: If true (default), re-index the corpus after deletion.

tools.name: delete

tools.description: Show the upload-manifest state of a corpus: how many server-uploaded files are tracked, which tracked files drifted (edited outside the API), which files on disk were never uploaded through the server (orphans), and which manifest entries have no file left. Read-only; changes nothing.

corpus.description: Single corpus name (not a list); must be in upload.allow.

tools.name: uploads_status

tools.description: Remove stale upload-manifest entries (entries whose file no longer exists on disk). Never deletes files: orphan files on disk are left alone. Dry run by default - pass apply=true to actually rewrite the manifest.

apply.description: If true, remove the stale entries. Default: false (dry run).

corpus.description: Single corpus name (not a list); must be in upload.allow.

tools.name: uploads_prune
